title: AuditAgentAction
description: A BACKWARD-INCOMPATIBLE candidate version, posted after contracts/32-audit-agent-action.v2-compatible.schema.json, used only by examples/32-ci-for-agent-facing-apis to prove the registry rejects a change that adds a new required field. Carries the same optional note field the compatible version added, so the one change relative to that version is the new required correlationId property below.

id.description: UUID of this record; the projection's idempotency key, so a redelivery folds exactly once

direction.description: INBOUND: a tool call the agent consumed. OUTBOUND: a model call its langchain4j code made.

actor.description: who or what: a caller identity for INBOUND, or model:<id> for OUTBOUND

action.description: the tool name (INBOUND) or the decision kind (OUTBOUND)

detail.description: a short, deterministic summary of the call or decision, never the model's own prose (OTel GenAI content capture stays off)

costUsd.description: derived from tokensIn/tokensOut alone, never from content; decimal string, set only for OUTBOUND

note.description: an optional free-text annotation, absent from every record written before the compatible version

correlationId.description: a new REQUIRED field with no default: a record written against any earlier version of this schema has no value for it, so a reader compiled against this version cannot parse that older record
